svg.font-family: Poppins, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Where the clicks went
svg.desc: Four measured findings show clicks leaving: 68 per cent of US Google searches ended without a click, Pew found an 8 per cent click rate with an AI summary against 15 per cent without, Seer found organic click-through on AI Overview queries fell from 1.76 to 0.61 per cent, and Chartbeat measured publishers down 60, 47 and 22 per cent. One number points the other way: pages cited inside the AI Overview saw organic click-through rise 35 per cent.
svg.text: 68% of US searches ended withno click, up from 60% in 2024
8% clicked with an AI summary,15% without. 1% inside it.
Organic click-through on AIOverview queries: 1.76% to 0.61%
organic click-through for pagescited inside the AI Overview.
The click did not disappear. It movedto whoever the machine named.
